## 中文原文

你周末早上醒得不算早，躺在床上刷了会儿短视频，磨蹭半天才起床。简单洗漱完，给自己泡了杯咖啡，烤了两片面包当早餐。吃完后收拾了一下桌子，把脏衣服扔进洗衣机，打算下午再出门逛逛。

## English translation

I didn’t get up early on Saturday morning. I lay in bed scrolling through short videos for ages before finally dragging myself out of bed.

After a quick wash, I made myself a cup of coffee and toasted two slices of bread for breakfast.

Once I’d finished eating, I tidied the table and tossed my dirty clothes into the washing machine.

I was planning to go out and wander around a bit later in the afternoon.
